name: 일류경제도시 대전 (Daejeon city promotion slogan)
verdict: A promotion slogan of Daejeon Metropolitan City, the club's host-city government, on the sleeve sponsor patch. Nothing found.
note: Sleeve sponsor (sponsor patch) of Daejeon Hana Citizen 2026 home kit, per the club store's '2026 스폰서패치' product image. Rating note: a municipal government of South Korea; state ownership alone is not a tier (METHOD.md), and no sourced record against Daejeon Metropolitan City found.
